response.justification: While Bogdan brings substantial software engineering experience and strong mentoring capabilities, he is fundamentally misaligned for this senior C++ systems role. His career has been centered on web and full-stack development (JavaScript, TypeScript, DLang) with only 6 months of documented C++ experience at National Instruments, whereas the role requires deep expertise in high-performance C++, multi-threading, and industrial systems architecture. He lacks critical domain expertise in industrial automation, IoT protocols, secure development lifecycle standards (IEC 62443), and concurrent systems programming. Additionally, his degree (BS Computer Science) does not meet the specified requirement for B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience spanning 18+ years across diverse technologies and platforms
Strong emphasis on testing, code quality, and mentoring others through TDD and knowledge-sharing initiatives
Full-stack capabilities and architectural thinking demonstrate adaptability and problem-solving skills
concerns: Only 6 months of documented C++ experience; career primarily focused on JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang web development
Educational background (BS Computer Science) does not match explicitly required B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech qualifications
No demonstrated experience with industrial automation, IoT, multi-threading systems, MQTT/message brokers, or IEC 62443 security standards
